text:
ellen: tiny update — meet Waffle. he discovered the office ficus and now believes it's his jungle. photo: https://imgur.com/a/waffle-ficus :evergreen_tree: :dog:
matt: Waffle for VP of Plant Relations. does he do watering or only supervisory bark-inspection? :laughing:
jia: 10/10 tail wag diplomacy. also love the tiny leaf in his fur. Waffle is clearly mature in stakeholder management. :herb: :dog2:
omar: Wondering if Waffle accepts coffee meeting invites or prefers long walks to negotiate treats. also can we get a squeaky toy budget request in for him? :money_with_wings:
irene: He will accept both, but only if you bring something from the bakery. pastry diplomacy works every time. also: who's bringing the tiny "Do Not Disturb - Nap In Progress" sign? :croissant:
matt: I can laser-cut a miniature sign. ETA: Friday. Waffle nap schedule pinned to the fridge. :calendar:
jia: Also pro tip: If you need keyboard clearing, place a banana on the desk. Waffle relocates there immediately. Observed behavior. :banana:
omar: Approved. New office policy: Bananas are an effective devops tool. filing this under "unusual but effective". :file_cabinet:
ellen: Quick logistics — if Waffle chills at your desk, please check for leaf confetti. He is a proud decorator. Also he has been doing a low-key fundraiser: treats for belly rubs. Suggested price: 2 cookies or 1 sincere compliment. :cookie:
jia: Donating 3 compliments today. Waffle is officially a morale boost. :sparkles:
irene: Vote: Waffle for honorary weekday mascot? react with :dog: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no. so far: ellen :dog:, matt :dog:, jia :dog:, omar :dog:.
